correctness.rationale: On each prism edge orbit, a two-horizontal-edge pair represents an original edge and a fixed rung represents its private whisker. Compatibility is exactly matching in W(G), and unused rungs extend every invariant simplex to a perfect prism matching. For the global Morse matching, fix core original-edge set S; leaf choices at vertices not covered by S form a simplex and toggle the smallest available leaf, except the empty-to-single-leaf pair in the empty core fiber. Downward edges can remove core edges but upward matched edges cannot add them, so acyclic; precisely core perfect matchings survive, plus one chosen whisker vertex. The resulting CW wedge has p(G) cells in dimension |V|/2-1, with correct k=1 discrete-S0 convention and n odd/isolated cases. Independently enumerated all 75 nonempty labeled graphs up to four vertices; stored verifier claims 76 including empty graph, with larger test cases. No finite check replaces the all-graph proof.
